# 50 · Q-M1f.572: whether a state's `open` facts are shown and counted with its facts

[← part 2](../README.md) · [← the phase](../../../README.md) · [your answers](../ANSWERS.md) ·
[the ledger](../../../../open_questions.md#q-m1f572--whether-a-states-open-facts-are-shown-and-counted-with-its-facts)

**From your answer to item 44**, 2026-11-19: *"All hypotheses generated by obligation rules also go into (open ...)
context. … (open R) also saved as fact. Not duplicate (open R) because they are ordinary facts, but kernel still
counts number of (open R) assertions as before."*

**The gap.** Held as ordinary facts, the `open` facts are in every listing of a state, in every count of its
facts, and in what makes two commitments one state. Nothing says whether that is meant.

Nothing is built: every run is today's engine, the gate build of master at `edbe6c3b`
(`build/review-bin/ein-head-edbe6c3b`), on the programs in [`programs/`](programs/). `tools/run.sh` re-takes them
into `runs/` (both ignored, so on this machine only).

## 1. What the runs show

[`a-drinks-hrule.ein`](programs/a-drinks-hrule.ein) is today: four candidates, held by no state.
[`b-drinks-asked.ein`](programs/b-drinks-asked.ein) holds them as facts, under `question`, which stands for
`open`. One against the other, the file's name apart (`runs/a-vs-b.lines.txt`):

| surface | lines that differ | what differs |
|---|---:|---|
| `ein solve` | 0 | |
| `ein show hyps` | 0 | |
| `ein oracle` | 0 | |
| `ein solve -p` | 98 | every one of the 12 states lists the four `(question …)` facts |
| `ein saturate --dump` | 180 | the four facts, the rule that concludes them, the counts |
| `--dump-answer` | 428 | every state's file and the counts in `answer.json` |

In *zebra2* written the same way it is 125 facts in each state ([item 45](../../../q-m1f.567_the_hrule_form_dropped/README.md)).

Here the facts are root's, the same in every state. Made again at each state's fixpoint, as you ruled, they are
another set in each state, where an obligation makes them: a candidate that would pay a debt already paid is not
made there.

## 2. What it touches

`ein solve -p`, the forms of `--dump-answer`, `ein saturate --dump`, the drawing of a knowledge base, the count
*facts beyond root*, the golden of every program that searches; and a state's identity: two commitments are one
state where they hold the same facts.

## 3. The options

- **(a)** Like any fact: listed, drawn and counted with a state's facts.
- **(b)** Held, and shown apart. A state's listing, its counts and its identity are of its other facts. The `open`
  facts are a section of their own in `-p` and in the dumps, drawn apart, and left out of a saved file, since
  loading it makes them again. **Default.** They are a function of the state's other facts, being written at its
  fixpoint, so identity loses nothing by leaving them out.
- **(c)** Held, and shown only by `ein show hyps` and to a rule that reads them.

## 4. Your call

(a), (b) or (c), in [`ANSWERS.md`](../ANSWERS.md) under item 50. Blank keeps (b).
